test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A watch dealer marks the price of a luxury watch 35% above its cost price. During an annual sale, the dealer offers a primary discount of 20% on the marked price. To attract more buyers, a second successive discount of y% is given. If the dealer's overall profit on the transaction is 8% of the cost price, find the value of the second discount y.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Let Cost Price (CP) = 100. Then Marked Price (MP) = 100 + 35% = 135. Price after first 20% discount = 135 × 0.8 = 108. Overall Profit = 8%, so Required Selling Price = 100 + 8% = 108. Since the price after the first discount (108) is already equal to the target selling price (108), the second discount y must be 0%. **∴ The correct answer is 0%.**
